== Card credits ==
Grady Hutchins is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of three cards.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Set 9]] (2018) and [[Virtual Set 14]] (2021), so the credited cards span 2018–2021. The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Grady Hutchins|Card Credits]].
